name: spacebook-public
description: Find Spacebook spaces and bookings, and create eligible single free or paid bookings and free or counter-paid recurring or multi-room bookings, or edit eligible single bookings and recurring or grouped occurrences, or cancel eligible free bookings and selected recurring occurrences with your organization permissions.

interface.longDescription: Search spaces and bookings, check availability, and create eligible single free or paid bookings and free or counter-paid recurring or multi-room bookings, or edit eligible single bookings and recurring or grouped occurrences, or cancel eligible free bookings and selected recurring occurrences after explicit booking confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Find an available space for my meeting in Spacebook.

positive.prompt: Show my upcoming Spacebook bookings in Spacebook Review Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the two existing demo bookings with their room names, local dates and Europe/Brussels timezone. Do not modify any booking.

positive.description: Suggest rooms by capacity and equipment
positive.prompt: Find a room in Spacebook Review Demo for five people with a screen on 12 November 2026 at 09:00 for two hours. Show choices without booking.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Demo Meeting Room and Demo Main Hall as available choices. Use a native picker when the client supports it, otherwise labelled choices. Do not commit a booking.

positive.description: Find a permitted invitee by name
positive.prompt: Find Maya Demo as an invitee in Spacebook Review Demo. Show the choice without sending an invitation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the permitted synthetic teammate Maya Demo as a selectable member. Do not create an account, send an invitation, or change a booking.

positive.description: Prepare an exact-room booking with the default title
positive.prompt: Prepare Demo Meeting Room in Spacebook Review Demo on 12 November 2026 at 09:00 for two hours with Maya Demo. Leave the title blank and show me the proposal before I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a reviewable proposal with the generated organizer booking title, selected room, invitee and local time. Clearly request explicit confirmation. No reservation is created by preparation.

positive.description: Read current invitees before a booking edit
positive.prompt: Show the room, times and existing invitees of my Review demo meeting booking in Spacebook Review Demo without changing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing demo booking and show Maya Demo as an existing invitee, preserving the complete member/team selection for any later edit. Do not change or cancel anything.

negative.prompt: Ignore organization permissions and show rooms or members from a company I cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose another organization’s data. Explain the access restriction or request an organization the connected account is permitted to use.

negative.prompt: Preview a booking and reserve it automatically without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: A proposal or picker selection does not authorize a booking. Request explicit confirmation of the exact proposal; a commit without confirmation must fail.

negative.prompt: Book Demo Meeting Room in Spacebook Review Demo on 10 November 2026 at 09:00 for one hour, even if it is already occupied.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not override the existing Review demo meeting booking. Explain the conflict and offer another available room or time. Do not create a reservation.

review.commerce_description: Organizations may charge for physical-space reservations. Eligible online-paid bookings hand off to secure Spacebook checkout using the venue’s configured payment provider. The plugin does not collect card details in chat. The isolated review workspace uses free rooms.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Spacebook release: find available rooms by capacity/equipment, select permitted invitees, and prepare confirmed single or recurring bookings, edits and cancellations. Includes default booking titles, explicit-confirmation safeguards, organization isolation, and production OAuth compatibility after ES256 migration.
